identity_state_layers.purpose: Campaign identity, policy, memberships, enabled content and authoring lifecycle.
GM/assistant/player/observer authority, delegation and controlled actor references.
Scene identity, parent/child structure, ordering, reusable Scene composition and lifecycle.
Templates, prerequisites, branch conditions, alternate Scene paths and outcome links.
Stable references to reusable Setting, Creature/NPC, Item, Vehicle, Species/Form, Ability and Encounter definitions.
Campaign-local placement, state, labels and permitted overrides without rewriting source Definitions.
Uploaded or linked map/media asset identity, versions, dimensions, provenance and authorized projections.
Grid kind, square cell size/scale, X/Y origin offset, calibration version, lock/recalibration and image-relative transform.
Stable square-cell coordinates, multi-cell areas, named zones and gridless semantic locations.
Cell/area/zone placement references, map layers, z/order/presentation metadata, hidden state and selection semantics.
Basic rooms, corridors, floors, walls, doors/openings, terrain/features, stairs/portals and reusable tile/stamp authoring.
GM-only, player-known, discovered, concealed and reveal-state projections across Scene/map content.
Encounter references, objectives, triggers, hazards, scripted hooks and durable event linkages without absorbing owning-domain rules.
Readiness validation, exact launch snapshot, frozen map/calibration/placement versions and Session binding.
Governed live amendments, current Session state, post-session outcomes, history and reusable-definition isolation.
Authorization-before-resolution, source/authoring provenance, expected-version/idempotency/recovery, and semantic nonvisual authoring.

map_coordinate_invariants: square and gridless are the required initial coordinate modes
grid overlay alignment state is distinct from camera pan/zoom view state
image asset bytes are not rewritten by calibration
square cells use stable integer column,row coordinates under a versioned calibration
multi-cell areas reference coordinate sets or governed region geometry rather than duplicating placed source objects
gridless Scenes retain named semantic locations/zones and nonvisual placement descriptions
